results.title: Abacum raises $60m Series B
results.content:
Abacum is the leading business planning platform that empowers finance teams to drive performance. It combines simplicity with enterprise-grade flexibility, enabling finance teams to save time, plan with confidence, and make better decisions, faster.
 The round is led by San Francisco-headquartered Scale Venture Partners, whose portfolio of enterprise software investments includes industry leaders such as DocuSign, HubSpot, Bill.com, and Box. [...] New York/London/Barcelona, 11th June 2025 - Abacum, the business planning software company founded by Julio Martínez and Jorge Lluch, today announces that it has raised a $60m Series B round led by San Francisco-headquartered Scale Venture Partners.

There was also strong participation in the round from global VC fund Cathay Innovation, with existing investors Y Combinator, Creandum, Kfund, and Atomico all doubling down on their backing for the “Office of the CFO” technology company. [...] Abacum is a global company headquartered in NYC, and with offices in London and Barcelona. The funding will be used to continue fueling its rapid U.S. expansion, with over 50% of its revenue already stemming from the U.S. market. It also unlocks the next phase of Abacum’s product innovation by doubling down on the following:

results.title: Meet the Team Behind Abacum
results.content:
Today Abacum is a global company headquartered in New York City, with offices in Barcelona, Toronto and Buenos Aires, building the most scalable AI-native FP&A solution for high-growth companies and scaling enterprises.

## We've raised $100M to make finance leaders the hero of their organization [...] So they set out to create the solution they always wished they had. In 2020 they founded Abacum on a simple conviction: finance teams shouldn't have to choose between rigid legacy software and endless spreadsheets. Planning should move as fast as the business it serves.
